title: MOWmentum Program
description: Use this service request to receive information to adopt a Median, Right-of-way, Triangle or traffic circle for beautification, parkways not eligible. The MOWmentum Program is designed to allow homeowner association groups, businesses and individuals an opportunity to adopt a portion of the public right-of-way for the purposes of maintaining and improving the property. **Adopt a Roadside is handled by TXDOT ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Are you participating in the Dallas Reforestation Program?
observedQuestions.branchFinding: Both answers showed the same remaining questions

options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for information about adopting a City median or right-of-way.
actions.why: For homeowner associations, businesses, or individuals seeking information about adopting and beautifying a City median, right-of-way, triangle, or traffic circle through the MOWmentum Program. The 311 request form asks for the adoption location and whether the applicant participates in the Dallas Reforestation Program.
actions.why_not: The MOWmentum Program does not cover parkways or the Adopt a Roadside program. If the concern is Adopt a Roadside, then contact TxDOT about that program.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "MOWmentum Program"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "MOWmentum Program"

actions.tagline: Contact TxDOT about adopting a roadside.
actions.why: For an Adopt a Roadside inquiry. The description for "MOWmentum Program" requests on the Dallas 311 website says TxDOT handles that program.
actions.how: Contact TxDOT about Adopt a Roadside
actions.how_formatted: Contact TxDOT about Adopt a Roadside
